validity.recommendation: Existence of a real proposed Wuzhou-area branch of the Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co., Ltd.) is corroborated; Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are consistent with all independent sources found. No action required on existence/classification.
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's own cited ref for Status (http://www.eiafans.com/thread-1279941-1-1.html) is a repost, on a Chinese EIA-professional forum, of a first-round environmental-impact public notice dated 2019-12-27: '广西天然气支线管网项目梧州天然气支线管道工程（蒙山段、苍梧段）环境影响评价第一次公示' (Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network Project — Wuzhou Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Works, Mengshan section + Cangwu section — first EIA public notice), filed by 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co., Ltd.), the same parent developer behind most of the other 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network' rows in this roster (confirmed independently via a Baidu Baike company page and multiple sibling-branch EIA/approval notices on official Guangxi government sites, e.g. sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn for the Hezhou branch, fgw.gxzf.gov.cn for the Cenxi branch). Verified live: url_verifier OK on eiafans for tokens '广西' / '蒙山' / '苍梧'. This independently confirms a real, named proposed project matching the GEM segment name ('Wuzhou Branch') and pipeline type (natural gas transmission branch line with new distribution/let-down stations and valve chambers — consistent with Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission). CAVEAT 1: the notice's own body text contains an internal inconsistency — the 'project name' line reads '广西天然气支线管网项目宾阳天然气支线管道工程' (...Binyang branch pipeline works), which does not match the Wuzhou/Mengshan/Cangwu title — almost certainly a copy-paste template error by the original forum poster reusing boilerplate from a different notice (Binyang is itself a separate GEM row, P7658), not evidence P7659 and P7658 are the same physical pipe (different segment names, different specs, different counties). Flagging for awareness, not recommending a merge. CAVEAT 2: the notice describes the Wuzhou branch as covering TWO distinct sub-segments under one public notice — Mengshan section (Guilin-Lipu Co. 30km + Wuzhou-Mengshan Co. 29.2km = 59.2km total, new Mengshan distribution station) and Cangwu section (Hezhou-Babu Dist. 12.6km + Wuzhou-Cangwu Co. 21.9km = 34.5km total, new Cangwu distribution station) — i.e. two separate branch lines merged under one GEM row with no Length recorded. Did not stage a Length fill given caveat 1 above (would want a second, independent confirmation of the exact km figures before pasting a value from a notice with a demonstrated copy-paste defect elsewhere in the same text) — recommend a human researcher pull the full underlying EIA report (docin.com/book118.com host similar Guangxi-Guangtou EIA reports for sibling segments) to confirm the 59.2km+34.5km figures before filling Length (~93.7km combined) and to decide whether this row should instead be split into two segments matching the source's own Mengshan/Cangwu split.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Most recent independent evidence found for THIS specific project (Wuzhou branch / Mengshan+Cangwu sections, developer Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co.) is the 2019-12-27 first EIA public notice — no second-round EIA notice, no formal government approval (核准批复), no construction or commissioning news was found despite multiple targeted Chinese-language searches (site-restricted and general), spanning >6.5 years to today (2026-07). This is a meaningful contrast: sibling Guangxi-Guangtou branch projects under the same umbrella program (Hezhou branch [Fuchuan/Zhaoping/Xindu sections], Cenxi branch) DID progress to published government approval and are documented on official gxzf.gov.cn pages, and a separate, unrelated Wuzhou-area trunk project run by a different developer (PipeChina's '桂东南环网' Southeast-Guangxi ring network, Wuzhou–Cenxi segment) was completed and commissioned in 2025 — but nothing further surfaced for THIS Guangtou-company Wuzhou branch specifically. GEM's current Status='shelved' (LastUpdated 2025-08-25) is itself an inference with no dated shelving evidence located; applying the dormancy rule from the actual evidence date (2019-12, not the sheet's LastUpdated stamp) rather than treating 2025-08 as a fresh baseline, the project has shown zero independent progress for >4 years, crossing the shelved-→4y-cancelled threshold. No fabricated ref per standing rule 2 — this is a presumed inference from silence, not a sourced cancellation.

summary: P7659 (Wuzhou Branch, Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network): existence + fuel/type confirmed via an independently-verified 2019 EIA public notice (Guangxi Guangtou developer), but flagged for spec concern (bjx.com.cn ref for Fuel/PipelineType/ProposalYear is an inaccessible anti-bot page whose 2021-03 proposal date sits oddly after the 2019-12 EIA notice), a Location ref added, and a stale->cancelled status recommendation given >6.5 years with zero independent progress evidence versus sibling projects that did progress.
